basis: Acute sarcoidosis defined by erythema nodosum and ankle arthritis/periarthritis; hilar lymphadenopathy alone does not establish lung damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: defining ankle arthritis/periarthritis represents direct inflammation of locomotor tissues.

basis: Developmental impairment and cardiac anomalies are defining features; strabismus occurs in 30-79%. Clinodactyly in 7/15 does not establish functional skeletal damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: common clinodactyly is minor digit dysmorphism without demonstrated functional damage; significant skeletal lesions are occasional.

basis: Factor VIII deficiency; joint bleeding occurs in 30-79%, but arthropathy, cartilage destruction and restricted mobility occur in only 5-29%; common lasting muscle damage is unestablished.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: joint bleeding and hematomas are frequent, but damaging joint sequelae are reported in only 5-29%; bleeding alone does not establish common lasting damage.

basis: Reactive lymphoid follicles occupy small-airway walls. Associated autoimmune disease, infection or immunodeficiency cannot be assumed for this concept.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: reactive BALT hyperplasia alone does not establish a specifically immune-mediated disease; associated autoimmune or immunodeficiency diagnoses are separate.

basis: Defining microcephaly and developmental impairment; laryngomalacia in 3/3 selected patients does not establish ≥30% prevalence across the broader 21-patient cohort.

decisions.pulmonary: none: laryngomalacia in 3 assessed patients and singleton lung findings have selected denominators; common pulmonary involvement across the disorder is unestablished.

basis: A benign capillary blood-vessel neoplasm; capillaries belong to the cardiovascular axis even when located within the breast.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: the lesion arises from capillary blood vessels, explicitly covered by this axis; its breast location does not remove its vascular origin.

basis: Peroxisomal metabolic disease with defining neurologic and retinal dysfunction; hearing loss affects most (>80%). Hepatic disease is common (>30%) but omitted under the four-axis cap.

decisions.hepatic: none under cap: hepatic dysfunction is common (>30%) and can be severe; defining neurologic, retinal and auditory dysfunction take the available organ slots.
decisions.ocular: primary: pigmentary retinal degeneration is explicitly defining and causes visual loss across the spectrum.
decisions.otologic: involved: sensorineural hearing loss affects most (>80%); retained as the fourth axis because primary is capped at three.

basis: Defined by speckled lentiginous nevi and cutaneous capillary malformations; common damaging ocular or neurologic involvement is not established.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: a defining capillary malformation is a structural disease of blood vessels, which are explicitly included in this axis.

basis: Defined by cardiac conduction toxicity and toxic cerebral dysfunction with confusion or altered mental status; nausea and visual symptoms do not establish additional organ injury.

decisions.neurologic: primary: toxic confusion and altered mental status are direct cerebral dysfunction explicitly included in the definition; delirium falls within this axis.

basis: Water-induced urticaria is a mast-cell-mediated skin disorder; uncertainty about the initiating trigger does not exclude its immune effector mechanism.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: mast-cell-mediated urticaria qualifies as immune-mediated disease even without an established autoimmune or IgE-mediated trigger.
